name: Front-to-Back Alpha Compositing
definition: A rendering technique to blend multiple semi-transparent 2D Gaussians (splats) into a final image by processing them in depth order (front-to-back) to correctly handle occlusion.
summary: Front-to-Back Alpha Compositing renders semi-transparent primitives from nearest to farthest, enabling early termination when transmittance drops below a threshold for significant speedup in dense scenes.
